prompt_engineering.integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Masterpiece Makoto Shinkai and Studio Ghibli anime style 8K animation: Inside a cozy rustic bakery bathed in radiant golden morning sunlight through stained-glass windows, a cheerful young anime baker with rolled-up sleeves and a dusting of white flour on his cheek expertly kneads a pillow of sourdough bread. Flour particles float gently in golden volumetric light rays. The camera performs a smooth tracking orbital shot around the wooden table: his five fingers rhythmically fold and press the elastic dough with authentic biomechanical squish physics. In the background, fresh baguettes and croissants glow golden-brown inside a stone wood-fired oven with crackling warm embers. The baker looks up with a warm radiant smile and sparkling expressive anime eyes as steam billows softly from a freshly baked loaf.
prompt_engineering.overall_soundscape: Soft rhythmic squishing of elastic dough on a floured wooden board, gentle puffs of airborne flour, crackling birch firewood in the stone hearth, and the baker's satisfied hum.
prompt_engineering.non_diegetic_music: Heartwarming Studio Ghibli-style acoustic waltz with gentle acoustic piano, soft accordion melodies, and warm emotive strings at 110 BPM in D major.
